description: This file contains the implementation of the Redis session handler class within the OpenCart system, responsible for session management using Redis as the backend store. It includes methods for reading, writing, destroying sessions, and handles Redis connection setup.
external_files: Configuration values via registry (CACHE_HOSTNAME, CACHE_PORT, CACHE_PREFIX, session_expire)
published: Opencart	ext	he class itself: Opencart\(System\(Library\(Session\)\)\)edis

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: Session handler class that manages sessions stored in Redis, providing methods to read, write, delete, and garbage collect sessions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection using the registry configurations, sets session key prefix.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from Redis using session ID, returns session data as an array.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to Redis, encoding it as JSON and setting expiration based on configuration.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from Redis for a given session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection, which Redis handles automatically, so this just returns true.
